## What's new

- MENU + X in a game takes a screenshot ("Screenshot Saved" shows over the
  game), and Take Screenshot in the in-game menu saves the paused frame.
- Screenshots, in the in-game menu, shows the game you're playing's
  screenshots full screen, newest first: left and right to go through
  them, X to delete one (X again to confirm), hold Y to hide the caption.
- Saved as PNGs in Screenshots/<console>/<game>/ on the card, also in
  ChaOS Transfer. Each console's Controls lists MENU + X.

---

ChaOS 0.9.8 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.8-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.8-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
